name: ES7210
description: The `es7210` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the ES7210 high performance four channel audio ADC ([datasheet](http://www.everest-semi.com/pdf/ES7210%20PB.pdf)). This allows attached microphones to be used as a microphone input via [I2S Audio](https://esphome.io/components/microphone/i2s_audio/).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x40`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) the ES7210 is connected to.

config_entries.label: Channel Gains
config_entries.description:
**Set at most one of:** `mic_gain`, `channel_gains`.

The individual gains applied to microphone channels 1 through 4, in that order. The list must contain exactly four values. Each value accepts the same gain levels as `mic_gain`. This option cannot be used with `mic_gain`.

config_entries.label: Mic Gain
config_entries.description:
**Set at most one of:** `mic_gain`, `channel_gains`.

The gain applied to the ADC microphones. One of `0dB`, `3dB`, `6dB`, `9dB`, `12dB`, `15dB`, `18dB`, `21dB`, `24dB`, `27dB`, `30dB`, `33dB`, `34.5dB`, `36dB`, or `37.5dB`. Defaults to `24dB`. This option cannot be used with `channel_gains`.

config_entries.label: Bits Per Sample
config_entries.description: The bit depth of the audio samples. One of `16bit`, `24bit` or `32bit`. Defaults to `16bit`.

config_entries.label: Tdm
config_entries.description: Enable four-channel time-division multiplexed (TDM) output. Enabling this option changes `SDOUT1` from a two-channel I2S output into a four-slot TDM stream containing microphones 1 through 4; `SDOUT2` is therefore not needed to receive all four microphones. When disabled, microphones 1 and 2 are output on `SDOUT1`, and microphones 3 and 4 are output on `SDOUT2`. TDM mode is not supported on the original ESP32 or ESP32-S2; setting `tdm: true` on either variant causes a configuration error. Defaults to `false`.
